neighbours.label: a comma or 'so' that joins a clause to a following clause spelling out its consequence or continuation
fire: The tax was spread across all the member states, and placing most of the cost on the largest economies.
Nearly the whole harvest was sold abroad so it was hard to find bread in the city.
The new phones will respond to speech, and users will simply say what they want.
She had only cut a few inches off so the haircut was over in minutes.
By going beyond the plot summary of the novel, which any student could memorize, the class learned to argue.
The fund collects money from many donors, and spending decisions are left to a small board.
Most of the rooms were already painted so one bucket was enough for the rest.
He wanted to die a hero rather than a coward, and thus be remembered by his village.
quiet: The tax was spread across all the member states. The largest economies paid the most.
Nearly the whole harvest was sold abroad. Bread was hard to find in the city.
The new phones will respond to speech. Users will simply say what they want.
She had only cut a few inches off. The haircut was over in minutes.
The class went beyond the plot summary of the novel. The students learned to argue.
The fund collects money from many donors. A small board decides on spending.
Most of the rooms were already painted. One bucket was enough for the rest.
He wanted to be remembered as a hero by his village.

notes: card shows ',' and ' so' at clause junctions; two probe rounds gave weak, inconsistent readings (one 0.25). Best guess, likely to fail.
